items.fact: Apitoria completed the acquisition of 80% of A1 Biochem Labs (India CRO); a related US entity, A1 Labs LLC, was bought for US$15.247mn (~Rs127 cr), a related-party transaction (seller Dr Rajendra Gadikota, director of A1 Labs India).
Sep-2026 shareholding: promoters 51.88%, FIIs 17.41%, DIIs 24.37%, government 0.05%, public 6.29%.

Q2FY27 results (Screener, consolidated): revenue Rs10,263 cr (+24% YoY), operating profit Rs2,153 cr (OPM 21%), other income Rs168 cr, depreciation Rs531 cr, profit attributable Rs1,126 cr (EPS Rs19.57). First quarter with Lannett.
